nodes.label: ADR-0010: Automation scheduler, quota-survival semantics
nodes.rationale: Unattended jobs are FIXED READ-ONLY pipelines (briefing/watch/reflect), never open agent loops — an unattended run has no human to catch an injection-steered action, so mutating tools are unreachable by construction. Quota-survival is designed in: INFRA failures defer (never kill a job), real failures backoff then fall back to natural cadence, >2h-late runs are honestly recorded missed, and SKIP LOCKED claims make ticking exactly-once and multi-instance-safe.
